name: sh-personal-income-tax
description: Saint Helena island personal income tax for tax year 2026 (1 April 2026 to 31 March 2027). Covers the £7,000 personal allowance, the 26% and 31% bands, the 21% and 26% production rates, dividends, capital gains, pension allowance, who must file, the P50 individual return, instalments and penalties. Records that the 2026 bill for a £7,150 allowance did not pass. Use for income tax, tax-free allowance, self-employed or refund questions on St Helena. Does not apply to Ascension or Tristan da Cunha.
